name: Gun Nest
description: Blocking builds a turret beside you that anyone can man. It fires your gun twice as fast.
details:
Your block still works as normal, and also builds a turret beside you on a clear spot (away from walls, shields, mines and other bodies; nothing else can be dropped onto it). Walk up to it and press Use (E) to man it, and E again to get off. While you man it you stand still, aim with your crosshair and fire the turret with your trigger.

The turret fires a copy of your gun as it was when you built it (every bullet stat and effect: damage, size, bounces, splits, napalm, mods...) at twice your fire rate, with its own ammo. It keeps those stats whoever mans it, and anyone can: teammates, or an enemy who walks up to it (its shots are theirs while they're on it).

It has health equal to your max health, can never be healed, and slowly wears down over time. You can only have one: while yours stands, blocking doesn't build another.
